copy.tagline: 自动生成新员工入职流程与任务清单
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果负责新员工入职安排，想自动化首周日程和任务分配。
copy.tagline_en: Automate new employee onboarding tasks and schedules
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you manage employee onboarding and want to automate first-week tasks.

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会按模板生成一张新员工入职单页,包括欢迎区(姓名/入职日/团队)、首周 5 天日程、经理与 buddy 卡片、学习路径列表、设备清单,以及“设置完成”的判断标准。
howto.when: 当用户要求制作新员工入职单页、首周计划或 onboarding 页面时触发。

say.text: 帮我做一张新员工入职单页,要有首周日程。
say.note: 会生成一张带 5 天日程的入职页。

say.text: 入职页里加上经理和 buddy 卡片,再列学习路径。
say.note: 会生成对应的卡片和路径列表。

say.text: 按模板写设备清单和“设置完成”的标准。
say.note: 会补齐 checklist 和 outcomes 区域。

howto.what_en: Once installed, Claude will generate a one-page new-hire onboarding document with a welcome hero (name, start date, team), a 5-day first-week schedule, manager and buddy cards, a learning-track list, an equipment checklist, and a 'you are set up if and only if' outcomes section.
howto.when_en: Triggers when the user asks for a new-hire onboarding page, a first-week plan, or an onboarding document covering schedule, equipment, or learning track.

say_en.text: Create a new-hire onboarding page with a first-week schedule.
say_en.note: Generates an onboarding page with the 5-day schedule.

say_en.text: Add manager and buddy cards, then list the learning track.
say_en.note: Adds the contact cards and a learning-track list.

say_en.text: Use this template for the equipment checklist and setup criteria.
say_en.note: Fills in the checklist and outcomes section.
